caption:
Holiday BNPL is climbing. 🎁

In a NerdWallet/Harris Poll survey, 38% of holiday shoppers expect to use buy now, pay later.

Of those, 38% expect they won't make every payment in full and on time.

If you use BNPL, put every due date in your calendar.

Planning to use it this season?
